description: Send guard for Arc: call before sending USDC or a token. Verdict stop / check / ok with reasons: a lookalike of an address the sender really used (address poisoning), bait from a forged transfer, a token contract or burn address, OFAC SDN or USDC blacklist, a fake USDC/EURC token, a brand-new address. A failed read is refused before payment. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_send_guard
